module: Flowgraph node "Is Walking Enabled" (category repeat_instant). Indicates whether the player is allowed to enter or exit a vehicle themselves, according to gameplay_walk.isTogglingEnabled(). Outputs: allowed (flow if allowed), denied (flow otherwise) and value (bool, hidden). Runs every frame.

work.desc: Every frame: reads gameplay_walk.isTogglingEnabled() and updates value, allowed and denied.
